copy_to_clipboard.description: macOS: paste the text through the clipboard (⌘V) and put the previous clipboard back; false types it key by key and leaves the clipboard alone. Linux always types the text.

trigger_mode.description: hold: record while the key is held. toggle: one press starts, the next press stops.

type_while_speaking.description: Toggle mode only: type the words while you speak, about two seconds behind your voice, instead of all at once at the stop.

trigger.description: macOS: the trigger key. Empty for Fn, or a keycode: 54 Right Command, 61 Right Option, 105 F13 (all in the menu). Linux under X11 always uses Right Ctrl; under Wayland your compositor binds the key.

omarchy_trigger.description: Omarchy: the dictation key, written by the Whispy bar panel (pick it there: it also rewrites ~/.config/whispy/shortcuts.lua and reloads Hyprland).
